|printed_lore=<span lang="ja">モグリのパイロット。無資格の宇宙船技術者。モス・アイズリーに秘密研究室を持つ。ハン・ソロの持つケッセル・ランの記録を破った豪語した。オビ＝ワンに出会った後、改心する。</span><ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' BoShek.<ref name="jp-face" />

'''Card text:''' Adds 3 to the power of a starship he pilots. Although he is not a smuggler, he can make a Kessel Run. Immune to attrition less than 3.<ref name="jp-face" />

'''Lore:''' An unlicensed pilot. An unqualified starship technician. Has a secret laboratory in Mos Eisley. Boasted that he had broken Han Solo's Kessel Run record. Reformed after meeting Obi-Wan.<ref name="jp-face" />

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese explicitly says he is not a smuggler; the English says he may make a Kessel Run in place of a smuggler. The Japanese lore calls him an unlicensed pilot and an unqualified starship technician, rather than the English “Rogue pilot” and “Outlaw starship tech,” and shortens Obi-Wan Kenobi to Obi-Wan.<ref name="jp-face" /><ref name="english-face">[[:File:Premiere-L-boshek-decipher-archive.gif|BoShek original English printed face]].</ref>
